findings.quote: The global South cannot simply become a destination for data centers while decisions about AI are made elsewhere.
findings.rationale: Calls for UN-enabled Global South participation in AI rulemaking and innovation, resisting corporate concentration and managing AI infrastructure demands on water, energy and land.
